capabilities: Define RSS feeds by tagging notes with a feed tag
Fetch the newest articles from all configured feeds via a command
Format fetched articles using a template.md file
Save each article as an individual Markdown note in a per-feed folder
Parse feed XML fields such as title, author, link, date and content
extras: The author warns that parsing is simple and not as compatible as mature RSS services, so parsing sometimes fails, and results are better on desktop than mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull articles from RSS feeds into the vault as notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses the xml-js library to parse RSS feeds.

summary: RSS feed reader that fetches articles from feeds declared as tagged notes and saves each article as a formatted Markdown note in the vault.
